name: LLM Usage Tracker & Cost Monitor with Node-Level Analytics

parameters.content:
### Defined by User
- Define the model name and standard name, even if you want to use same name. (Why? because we will use the standard name to find the cost of this model)
- Model prices are per million token
### Check all model names are correctly defined

Where is the execution ID?
In your workflow at the top center, you can see "Executions," and you can select any execution to see the ID, which is a number like 323.
In case you did something incorrectly, you can see what models you missed to add and define

You can do anything with this info:
- Send a follow-up message with cost
- Send another request to continue a process ...
